basis: BLAZER-PREP workflow binding (Release-owned): the operator inputs that os-release.yml mode blazer-prep passes to scripts/blazer-build-only.py run. The host is the existing original builder (Infra reconciliation of a709ab3: protocols-465723/us-west2-a/immortal-os-builder, runner selectors [self-hosted, roseos-frankel-builder]); the lock is os/release-pipeline/frankel.json host.lockPath. sourceRoot (the isolated work tree, fixed across the source, vendor and lunch dispatches), downloadDir and node are the historical facts of the metadata-only inspect receipt of run 41473133543 attempt 1 (Infra proposal 01a19e54, 2026-11-02): both directories were absent, their parent existed, and /usr/local/bin/node was a regular executable file whose version was never run. They are not current host proof: on every run the helper re-checks absence, isolation from the production tree, symlinks, collisions, space, the lock and (vendor) the node identity, and refuses otherwise. The source stage needs only sourceRoot. A completed source copy is a production working-tree byte snapshot with project revisions and the pinned manifest unverified (PR395); nothing here claims a manifest-verified tree. The receipt directory is a fresh per-attempt directory under the runner's temp directory. Nothing here was run on any host.
